It covers a wide range of biometric modalities such as fingerprint, iris recognition, face spoof detection, and multimodal biometrics. The papers also delve into topics like feature extraction, template protection, and the challenges of biometric systems under spoofing attacks.

It explores the historical, social, and technological aspects of computing from its early origins to contemporary advancements.
